caption:
Apple “Pie” Breakfast Quinoa 
healthy fats | filling breakfast | one pot wonder | 30 minute recipe | lazy girl breakfast 

This breakfast quinoa is an absolute delight and unbelievably simple to prepare! It’s essentially a fusion of homemade applesauce and quinoa. 
Not only does this dish boast a wealth of fiber, but it also provides protein from the quinoa! 
It’s a well-rounded breakfast that promises to keep you feeling full and content throughout the entire morning.

Nutrition: 
C: 59  F: 5 | P: 8
Calories: 294 per serve
Serves 2

Ingredients
2 apples
1/2 cup quinoa
1 1/2 cup water
1 1/2 tsp cinnamon 
1 tsp jaggery powder / date syrup / monkfruit ( sweeten as per taste ) / wanna keep it natural? once cooked, add in half to one mashed banana 
1 tsp peanut butter 

2 tbsp greek yogurt, for topping

Method: 
peel, core and cut up apples into normal cubes 
in a pot, add in apples, water, rinsed quinoa and let it boil
then cover and cook for 20-25 minutes till apples are soft and quinoa is cooked through
take it off the heat and leave it covered for 5 minutes
plate it up in 2 bowls

to serve, a lovely handful of granola will add a good crunch and some greek yogurt will give you a faux whipped cream!!!
a tsp of peanut butter is lovely too :)
